seal.statement: Withdraw every comparative benchmark claim whose evidence is invalid (timeouts counted as success, /health substitutes, unverified envelopes, non-canonical workloads, constant phases/bytes, fabricated quantiles, label-hash identities, wrong dispatch family), retaining the original records as forensic history behind an append-only invalidation ledger; repair the comparative benchmark system into one canonical chain (typed operation outcomes with retained responses, canonical Scenario A workload through the existing adapters and shared open-loop/retry/sweep/semantic owners, fail-closed readiness and dataset verification, running-container identity, claim-specific admission, renderers that consume admitted claims only, offline recomputation) with the registered lab machines as the default execution target; prove with adversarial acceptance tests that the chain cannot publish a successful result when the product did not run, the wrong workload ran, the answer was wrong, the request timed out, the topology differed or the evidence is missing; and demonstrate one semantically verified real-product smoke run for Lagrange, TiDB and PostgreSQL on lab hosts, published as smoke.

(2) The GCP campaign digest sha256:5437366a is not on Docker Hub (docker-loaded from a controller tarball); the Hub 0.4.0 tag is a fifth artifact (manifest sha256:c0fcc0d3, id 18aeffc9). (3) On a Hub-image 3-node cluster that passes the deployer's readiness predicate (/health ready:true means only that a SQL engine object exists), CREATE TABLE answers contractState pending / schema_replica_convergence_pending; replicas become active Raft services on nodes 1 and 3 at 19:52:53Z, yet the serve lane stays blocked (PRIORITY_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY_PENDING, then planning_snapshot_refresh_pending / config_safe_mode; provisioning restarts with required=2 provisionable=0/1; rebalancer topology_settling_blocked node_ready_lease_incomplete for all three nodes; learner_address_unresolvable on node 3; replica_operations-p1 participant write timeouts); every Scenario A UPDATE on every node answers after ~29.8 s with DISTRIBUTED_PARTICIPANT_FAILURE Partition service not found; the table never became routable in 13 minutes. (4) The canonical adapter's dataset preparation fails with SQLSTATE 55P03 Schema provisioning remains active for its 120 s budget - a product finding reached through the documented public contract. (5) The published 4-node 153-byte answers match the TABLE_NOT_FOUND envelope (152 B): the 4-node 'fast' results were errors. Classification: client handling (D01) hid a product failure; the product failure is owned by formation/readiness convergence, not by the benchmark.
